definitions.CLOSED: Every currently implemented route in the stated operation scope enters one reviewed terminal-independent application boundary; missing future adapters do not make a current route mixed.
definitions.MIXED: A reviewed application boundary exists, but at least one current route, lifecycle phase, or conflicting evidence still leaves ownership outside that boundary.
definitions.LEGACY: Review proved that the command or presentation layer remains the effective owner of application policy.
definitions.N/A: Review and tests proved that the application-boundary question does not apply to this operation.
definitions.UNREVIEWED: No route-closure conclusion has been made; this is not evidence that the operation is legacy.

add.reason: The typed batch, authority, mutation, CLI, TUI, public, and agent routes are verified against one application/runtime boundary.

atomize.reason: The CLI freezes a Context or direct-Memory target and enters one analysis-to-in-place-application boundary; retained records support exact recovery, non-applying Impact, and read-only Review without an Atomize-owned resolution route.

compare.reason: The default CLI enters one transient source-revalidated summary application, while CLI, TUI, Python, and agent deep routes retain the targetless exhaustive Run, exact Open, and version-bound Refresh lifecycle with no Context Apply.

copy.reason: CLI, Embed-shaped multi-Memory TUI, Python, and agent routes share one provider-free ordered direct-Memory plan, including exact READ Grant bindings, local-only Target placement, mandatory fresh output UIDs, atomic checkpoint, and Undo/Redo boundary.

distill.reason: CLI, TUI, public, agent, Ground, provider, and prepared-result routes share the reviewed Distill application contract.

makemore.reason: CLI, TUI, public, agent, Ground, provider, and prepared-result routes share the reviewed Makemore application contract, including the best-effort default, explicit strict gate, quality-bound receipt projection, and read-only compatibility for former Elaborate checkpoints.

embed.reason: Context and Memory live-link CLI/TUI, Python, and agent routes share typed placement, local or READ-granted Source freeze, content-free live authority bindings, CAS Apply, and checkpoint contracts through one terminal-independent operation boundary.

find.reason: CLI, TUI, Python, and agent routes share one provider-free readable-source freeze and complete literal or explicit-regex span result. The interactive checked-result save is a separate reviewed typed application edge and leaves its readable Sources unchanged.

find-ambiguities.reason: Direct, Profile-wide, selected TUI, public Python, and agent routes share one authorized frozen Source and typed ambiguity analysis boundary; the operation remains read-only and Review remains a separate consumer.

find-conflicts.reason: Direct, Profile-wide, selected TUI, public Python, agent, and JSON-handoff routes share one authorized frozen Source and typed conflict analysis boundary; Resolve revalidates a separate application request.

fit.reason: General and Ground Fit routes share typed application/runtime execution and one terminal-independent compact receipt projection; standalone Fit has no TUI route.

forget.reason: CLI, TUI, Python, and agent routes share one complete-frame process-local Analyze, Select, Revise, authority/CAS Apply, and exact in-process replay lifecycle.

help.reason: Bare CLI, Python, and agent discovery remain Store-free and provider-free over the canonical catalog; the positional CLI request route freezes the same complete catalog in a terminal-independent application, uses one bounded provider turn only to select exact IDs, and renders canonical Help rows without execution or partial publication.

init.reason: Ordinary Context initialization has one typed terminal-free transaction and independent exact-name CLI/TUI presenters; Study initialization remains a separate operation.

merge.reason: Direct and recursive Merge planning, review, application, and presentation use the same frozen typed plan and runtime.

move.reason: CLI, Embed-shaped multi-Memory TUI, Python, and agent routes share one provider-free local ownership-transfer plan, complete inbound-link freeze, default atomic live-Embed retargeting with explicit Break, and one-unit Undo/Redo boundary; explicit granted Sources fail with the Copy-then-local-Move boundary.

meld.reason: CLI, TUI, Python, and agent routes share typed Start, Restart, saved-turn, cache/provider, CAS, and Apply lifecycles with exact/equivalent/projected reuse and one reviewed-session version contract.

pwd.reason: The only current route is a typed terminal-independent current-Context read with a one-line CLI presenter.

query.reason: Ordinary, granted, and query-only families plus CLI, TUI, public, and agent projections have a verified operation package. The interactive answer save crosses a separate typed require-new application edge without reopening QUERY-only Sources.

reference.reason: CLI, TUI, Python, and agent routes share one provider-free frozen local or explicit READ-granted Memory Source, local Target snapshot, content-digest revalidation, atomic checkpoint, and immutable stored-value contract.

replace.reason: CLI, TUI, Python, and agent routes share one complete local-scope frozen plan, exact-digest review, atomic multi-Context Apply, and operation-unit Undo/Redo boundary without provider or cache use.

resolve.reason: Direct-Memory Fit repair exposes CLI, TUI, public, and agent projections over one typed analysis, exact replay, authority, and checkpointed Apply boundary.

dedun.reason: Dedun reuses the closed exact-plus-semantic analysis, keeps every recursive Context as an independent direct frame, prepares all deterministic earliest-UID survivors before publication, and applies a local lexical subtree as one reference-safe rollback-safe Undoable command unit; direct Grant and exact replay routes retain their existing boundary.

dedup.reason: The CLI and public Python routes enter one provider-free role-aware exact application boundary for direct or local lexical reach, retain first-in-Context occurrence UIDs without cross-Context or cross-role grouping, and publish recursive changes atomically as one Undoable command unit.

delete.reason: CLI and TUI aliases, public Python, and agent routes share one terminal-independent Delete package; checkpointed direct-item removal remains Undoable, while exact-plan Context deletion is separately approved, permanent, lifecycle-recorded, and explicitly non-Undoable.

find-duplicates.reason: The CLI and public Python routes share one provider-free role-aware exact-group analysis for direct or readable lexical reach, preserve each Context as an independent Memory, Embed, and Reference frame, and publish a complete typed read-only report without mutation or checkpoint creation.

find-redundancies.reason: CLI, public Python, and agent routes share one frozen DUN analysis for an exact root or readable lexical subtree: recursive Contexts remain independent direct semantic frames, same-role exact items remain typed, all frames validate before publication, and only the separate Dedun adapter enters the survivor and Apply boundary.

sever.reason: Analysis, cache reuse, saved-session review, save-location revision, and both self-save and other-save Apply execute through typed application/runtime boundaries.

show.reason: CLI direct/recursive scope, Python, agent, and Find follow-up routes share one live typed inspection application boundary with one-snapshot targeting, readable-catalog traversal, READ-Grant projection, and structural query-only concealment.

status.reason: Detailed, compact, recursive, lineage, local, and granted CLI routes share one typed read-only inventory, bounded preview, relationship, and recent-checkpoint application/runtime boundary.

summarize.reason: Direct and recursive reads share one terminal-independent application result with independent plain and TUI presenters.

switch.reason: Explicit CLI, interactive picker, checkout-compatible selection, and bounded previous/next traversal share one typed global/relative/history target, READ authorization, target validation, and current-pointer/history CAS boundary.

trace.reason: Explicit Context, current or historical Memory, MemoryRef, granted-current, interactive catalog, recent, JSON, and bounded text routes share one typed target catalog and terminal-independent Trace request/result boundary.

branch.reason: Explicit CLI, interactive setup, checkout -b compatibility, exact and recursive planning, require-new publication, current-pointer transition, and command-unit recovery share one typed Branch application/runtime boundary.

chunk.reason: The CLI and historical Python compatibility routes share one operation-owned mechanical split domain, direct-Memory plan, and authorized checkpointed publication boundary.

clear.reason: Exact and recursive CLI routes share one typed request/result and operation runtime for target resolution, Grant boundaries, complete subtree freezing, checkpointing, and atomic publication.

contexts.reason: The only current route freezes one read-only local-plus-Grant hierarchy into a terminal-independent typed catalog before CLI presentation.

redo.reason: The CLI enters one fixed Redo adapter over the shared fail-closed granted-versus-local restoration selector and preserves one durable redo operation identity.

undo.reason: The CLI enters one fixed Undo adapter over the shared fail-closed granted-versus-local restoration selector and preserves one durable undo operation identity.

translate.reason: The CLI enters one typed Translate application family for targeting, catalog reuse/refresh, curation, strict import/export, provider orchestration, and both checkpointed Context actions; command-independent catalog meaning lives in Core and durable record/CAS mechanics live in Persistence.

search.reason: Search analysis and the shared selection-save boundary now have verified Search and Find callers, but the newly broadened capability has not yet completed a callable-wide review across every exposed adapter.

update.reason: Apply policy and recovery are verified, but the remaining Update routes have not been traced into one complete reviewed application boundary.
